A continuation of a previous story in the world of Shinrabansho. Stunned by the weird changes to her mother, Asmodeus confronts the Lard monster and agrees to a duel. But when the enemy has mind-control at his disposal, you might find yourself convinced that certain types of "dueling" are more normal than they really are. Very hot! I wish there was more!
